title: HB417 (2017 Regular): AN ACT relating to interference with an authorized individual's right to concealed carry.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Draft, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/17RS/HB417/bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 1581203))

operative_text:
Section 1 (KRS 237.137): (2) (a) Any person who prevents or attempts to prevent an individual authorized under subsection (1) of this section from carrying a concealed firearm shall be guilty of a violation subject to a fine of: 1. Five hundred dollars ($500) for a first offense; 2. One thousand dollars ($1,000) for a second offense; and 3. Two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500) for a third or any subsequent offense.
Section 1 (KRS 237.137): (b) A citation for the violation may be issued to an individual or an establishment where the violation occurs.
